chunks: And everything in this book that is narrated from Al-Fadl ibn Shadhan regarding the causes (reasons) he mentioned from Imam Al-Ridha (peace be upon him) has been transmitted by me from Abdul Wahid ibn Abduws Al-Naysaburi Al-Attar - may Allah be pleased with him - from Ali ibn Muhammad ibn Qutaybah, from Al-Fadl ibn Shadhan Al-Naysaburi, from Imam Al-Ridha (peace be upon him).

key_terms.النَّيْسَابُورِيِّ: Al-Naysaburi, referring to the origin of the narrator
key_terms.الْفَضْلِ بْنِ شَاذَانَ: Al-Fadl ibn Shadhan, a prominent narrator
key_terms.عَبْدِ الْوَاحِدِ بْنِ عَبْدِوسَ: Abdul Wahid ibn Abduws, a narrator in the chain

ai.seo_question: How is the transmission chain for Al-Fadl ibn Shadhan's narrations from Imam Al-Ridha verified in this text?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Saduq provides a precise genealogical link for the *Alal* (causes/illnesses) narrations, tracing the report from Imam Al-Ridha (as) through Al-Fadl ibn Shadhan to the specific narrator Abd al-Wahid ibn Abd al-Wasit al-Naysaburi. This clarification underscores the meticulous attention to *isnad* continuity in Shia hadith scholarship, ensuring that the specific medical or spiritual causes attributed to the Imam are authentically preserved through recognized transmitters.
